# Normalization stage 2 report (#72): file paths

94 seeds (track, MusicBrainz id, no library/negative buckets), 1096 harvest queries, 44968 counted files on 90 seeds. Generated by `python -m scripts.corpus.path_layout`.

A file counts when it's audio, within ±3 s of the MusicBrainz length, its filename has every title word and the main artist is somewhere in the path. So artist-less paths and other spellings of the artist aren't measured here (a hand check of the looser rule found ~2 in 100 right-song files without the artist). Shares are of counted files; only counts are reported (no peer names or paths).
